text:
Carmen (CEO): Following up on the all-hands reorg segment  leaving answers here for the Qs we didn't get to.
Devon (People Ops): Quick: if my open req gets repurposed to infra, does hiring manager approval suffice or do we need finance sign-off?
Carmen (CEO): Manager + receiving manager sign-off is usually enough for same cost center. Finance sign-off if it crosses cost centers or increases spend. Use the OrgOps form.
Marcus (Manager): For teams losing headcount, is contractor coverage auto-approved until backfill?
Devon (People Ops): We authorize up to 8 weeks of contractor coverage automatically. If you need longer, submit a business case and we'll review in the weekly headcount sync.
Abe (Head Eng): Can we expedite critical infra hires? We have two outages risk if we don't staff.
Lina (Recruiting): Mark reqs with tag "critical-infra" in Greenhouse and ping me. We can allocate an extra sourcer and move to a 2-week interview SLA for those.
Zoe (Staff Eng): Leveling confusion: are IC->Senior expectations changing after the reorg? Some teams feel the bar shifted.
Devon (People Ops): We'll run a cross-org calibration session next Tue 9am PT and publish concrete rubric changes. If you have examples, DM me so we can include them.
Marcus (Manager): How are verbal offers handled if bands change mid-offer?
Devon (People Ops): Verbal offers will convert at the band active at offer acceptance. If band increases within that window, we'll apply a one-time uplift at manager discretion.
Carmen (CEO): Were prioritizing transparency: the headcount matrix (by team + cost center) will be posted to the handbook by EOD. Link: <https://redwood.company/handbook/live-headcount>
hr-bot: Reminder: OrgOps form deadline for proposed swaps is Friday 5pm PT.
Lina (Recruiting): Referral policy note: referrals apply only to net-new hires; internal reassignments excluded. We'll update the referral page to make this explicit.
Zoe (Staff Eng): If an IC moves to a central team, do they keep their manager for performance reviews?
Carmen (CEO): Transition path: receiving manager handles day-to-day; original manager will remain in the loop for promotion calibration during the quarter. We'll add this to the migration playbook.
Marcus (Manager): Any guidance for communicating these changes to customers if a product lead moves?
Abe (Head Eng): Product owners should notify key customers 2 weeks before handover; we'll provide an email template in #all-hands-docs.
Devon (People Ops): Office hours for managers to walk through swaps and forms: Thurs 2pm PT. Calendar event coming from hr-bot.
Carmen (CEO): Thanks everyone 389. If you need exceptions (offers/promo edge cases), cc Devon + Lina and we'll triage. Leaving thread open for follow-ups.
